Common questions
These are the questions we hear most often.
Is FirstPromoter only for SaaS businesses?
No, it’s not. FirstPromoter works for any subscription or recurring-revenue business. Try it for free and see how it works for YOUR business!
Can I manage both affiliate and referral programs?
Yes — FirstPromoter lets you run affiliate programs, referral programs, and reseller programs all from one dashboard, with separate tracking links and commission structures for each.
How does commission tracking work?
We track referrals via unique links and cookies. When a referred visitor signs up and converts, the commission is automatically attributed to the promoter who sent them.
Can I make payouts directly from my Stripe account?
FirstPromoter integrates directly with Stripe, PayPal, and Wise so you can pay your affiliates in bulk with just a few clicks — no manual bookkeeping required.
Don’t see the answer you need?
That’s ok. Just drop a message and we will get back to you ASAP.

Common questions
These are the questions we hear most often.
How do the plan tiers work?
FirstPromoter plans are based on the monthly revenue your affiliates generate, not your total revenue. Starter covers up to $5,000/month in affiliate-driven revenue, Business up to $15,000/month, and Enterprise tiers go above that. Team members are unlimited on every plan.
What happens when I pass my plan’s revenue limit?
Your account moves to the next plan tier so tracking and commissions continue without interruption.
Is there a limit on affiliates or team members?
Team members are unlimited on every plan. Starter includes up to 1,000 affiliates; Business and Enterprise have no affiliate limit.
How does the free trial work?
Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial . No credit card required, and nothing is charged until you subscribe.
Which plan includes a custom domain?
Business and higher. Host your affiliate dashboard at your own address, like affiliates.yourdomain.com, with SSL included.
Don’t see the answer you need?
Just drop a message and we will get back to you ASAP.

Stripe helps you accept payments online and in person, integrate financial services, power custom revenue models and build a more profitable business.

Zapier

Integration FAQ
Setup, tracking, and what to do when your tool isn’t on the list.
My billing provider isn’t listed. Can I still use FirstPromoter?
Yes, Stripe, Chargebee, Paddle, Recurly and Braintree connect directly. Any other billing system connects through the API, which tracks sales, refunds, upgrades and cancellations.
Do I need a developer to set up an integration?
Direct billing integrations are configuration, not code: connect your provider and go live the same day, typically in about 15 minutes. Custom or JavaScript integrations depend on your setup and developer availability, and support is available either way.
My website platform isn’t listed. What are my options?
Use the universal tracking script or the API for custom-built sites and apps. Zapier, Make and Albato cover connections to thousands of other tools.
Can I track conversions server-side?
Yes. Your backend sends conversion events directly to the tracking API, and postback URLs are supported for server-side conversion tracking.

How to connect FirstPromoter with Stripe
What is Stripe?
Stripe helps businesses accept payments, manage finances and grow revenue with simple tools for online and in-person transactions.
How FirstPromoter works with Stripe
Our connection with Stripe allows us to seamlessly generate, assign and adjust commissions for your affiliates for any sales, refunds, upgrades, downgrades or cancellations that is made on your Stripe account.

We are able to do this by using Stripe’s web-hooks and API implementation. To get started, you will only need to install the FirstPromoter Stripe app from your FirstPromoter dashboard and you should see the magic happen when any of your referrals make payment.
How to connect FirstPromoter with Stripe
1

2

3

How Stripe can help you
Manage payments, capture recurring revenue and reach customers in 46+ countries. Stripe’s integrated suite simplifies financial operations to help cut costs and boost revenue.
Integrated financial and payments suite
Cut costs, boost revenue, and streamline your business operations with a fully integrated platform. Use Stripe to manage all your payment needs, handle revenue operations, and launch new business models.
Global reach
Stripe operates in 46 countries, with more on the way. Sell to customers worldwide as soon as Stripe supports your country.
Capture recurring revenue
Support recurring business models, reduce churn, and automate your finance operations.
Frequently Asked Questions
These are the questions we hear most often.
Is FirstPromoter only for SaaS businesses?
No, it’s not. FirstPromoter works for any subscription or recurring-revenue business. Try it for free and see how it works for your business!
Can you make payouts directly from the Stripe account?
Not at this time. Stripe has country and withdrawal limitations and requires individual verification. This is a big friction point for affiliates to sign up, whilst almost everyone has a PayPal account. Even if you don’t want to use PayPal, you can still pay your affiliates by any method you like as long as you mark the payout as completed in FirstPromoter.
Can I use my own domain name?
Yes. Your promoters will be able to sign up and access their dashboard from your own subdomain like https://affiliates.yourwebsite.com. By default, the referral links look like https://yourwebsite.com?fpr=referralid or https://yourwebsite.com/#_r_referralid so you’ll get full SEO benefits.
What’s the affiliate cookie life?
The default cookie life for referral links is 60 days, but we can change it to any value. If a visitor signs up within 60 days after the first visit following a referral link, their sales will be tracked as affiliate sales and commissions/rewards will be attributed.
Will affiliate marketing work for my business?
Like with any marketing channel, patience and the amount of allocated resources will contribute immensely to the end result. For some companies the program ramps up by itself, for others it may require more effort. In any case, we recommend giving it at least a year before closing it down: one big influencer or partner can turn the ROI of your program around.
How long are your contracts?
We offer both monthly and yearly plans with 2 months free. You can upgrade, downgrade or cancel your monthly plan at any time with no further obligation.
Are you GDPR compliant?
Yes, we are GDPR compliant.
Don’t see the answer you need?
That’s ok. Just drop a message and we will get back to you ASAP.
